defects.title: Nest configuration dependency resolved vulnerable lodash
defects.evidence: pnpm audit identified GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc through @nestjs/config; workspace override upgraded lodash to 4.18.1; production audit reports no known vulnerabilities.

defects.title: Web container restart caused by over-restrictive capability drop
defects.evidence: nginx could not initialize cache directories with all capabilities dropped; retained no-new-privileges for web, rebuilt/recreated it, and loopback HTTP became healthy.

defects.title: Angular compact payloads did not match strict API inputs
defects.evidence: Bounded normalization and approved delivery paths now pass public browser verification.

defects.title: Firestore rejected optional undefined event fields
defects.evidence: Firestore optional-property handling enabled; the live diagnostic through reauthentication now persists.

defects.title: Google authentication inline handler was blocked by edge CSP
defects.evidence: Allowed authentication-provider inline bootstrap execution while retaining self-only defaults, no objects, denied framing, restricted Google script/frame/connect origins, and all other edge controls; reloaded nginx and verified the public header.
